svg.aria-label: Graphic placement schematic for the Jordan holiday jacquard knit sweater, back view with measured callouts, size L base
svg.text: JM-H26-001 · HOLIDAY JACQUARD KNIT SWEATER · SIZE L BASE · ALL DIMENSIONS IN INCHES
Cuff: 2.5 in 2x2 rib, Gym Red, linked · cuff opening 9.5 relaxed
Bicep 19, 1 in below armhole · set-in sleeve, flatlock at shoulder and underarm
Collar: 1 in 2x2 rib, Gym Red, linked
Rows, top to bottom, per band sequence A to F
Full repeat 6.5. Continuous around body and sleeves,
matched at side seams within 0.25, best effort at armhole
Max float 0.5, caught. Motifs centered CF and CB, symmetrical
Hem: 3 in 2x2 rib, Gym Red, linked, no roll
Side seam: linked, flatlock interior, no vents
Motif sizes: Jumpman 1.75 x 1.5, tree 1.5 x 1.25, snowflake 1 x 1
Graphic is knit-in jacquard. No print, transfer or embroidery.
Main label: woven damask 2 x 0.75, center back neck, interior
Size tab below. Back neck tape 0.75 woven twill, tonal black
Care label: woven satin, left interior side seam, 2 in below armhole
Front: same rows and trims, crew neckline, 3.5 in drop at CF. See tech pack for graded spec S to 3XL.
Gym Red · PANTONE 19-1763 TCX · Ne 20/2 cotton/elastane
12-gauge fully fashioned jacquard, linked and seamed. Enzyme wash. Red rib matched across neck, cuffs, hem.
Graphic placement schematic · Size L base · Holiday 2026 · Rev 1.0 · Self-initiated concept, not a Jordan Brand or Nike document
